items.summary: During winter, in India, Demoiselle Crane sightings largely happen in Gujarat and Rajasthan. On February 28, 2026, the first sighting of a Demoiselle Crane was reported from Chennai Metropolitan Area. The only other records of Demoiselle Crane sighting from Tamil Nadu comes from Vijayanarayanam Tank in Tirunelveli. Naman Bora and Amoggh Chatty found the vagrant bird feeding in the reeds at Nemmeli salt pans near Chennai; the former would return to the spot the next three days and find the bird tenaciously clinging to this feeding spot

items.title: Advocates and court staff perform essential duties: Delhi HC says while exempting them from non-BS VI vehicle ban
items.summary: The government has failed to explain how non-BS VI vehicles have suddenly become a major contributor to pollution, the Delhi High Court observed while exempting lawyers and court staff working in Delhi courts from the ban. Justice Amit Mahajan noted that these vehicles were allowed in the capital till last month. "The respondents have also not been able to point out, at this stage, how the same vehicles which were though not contributing to the pollution till the month of October, are suddenly being considered as a major contributor to the pollution," the Court observed. It added that advocates and court staff perform essential duties. "Once the Courts are functional, the Advocates and the Court staff’s attendance is, undoubtedly, of utmost importance for the smooth functioning of the Court and they cannot be directed to not ply their vehicles. It is not the case of the respondents that they have been providing adequate transport to the Advocates and the Court staff for coming to the Courts," Justice Mahajan said.
